CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_DIMMARKETSEGMENT
AS
BEGIN

INSERT INTO DW.DimMarketSegment (
	MarketSegmentSK
	,MarketSegmentID
	,MarketSegmentName
	,MarketSegmentDescription
	,LowerLimit
	,UpperLimit
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	'1' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'MM1' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'MM' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'TRB < P2K' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,0 AS LowerLimit
	,2000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION

SELECT
	'2' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'MM2' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'MM' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'P2K <= TRB < P5K' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,2000 AS LowerLimit
	,5000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
	'3' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'MM3' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'MM' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'P5K <= TRB < P100K' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,5000 AS LowerLimit
	,100000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
	'4' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'MM4' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'MM' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'P100K <= TRB < P500K' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,100000 AS LowerLimit
	,500000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
	'5' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'MA' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'Mass Affluent (MA)' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'P500 <= TRB < P3M' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,500000 AS LowerLimit
	,3000000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
	'6' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'UA' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'Upper Affluent (UA)' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'P3M <= TRB < P10M' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,3000000 AS LowerLimit
	,10000000 AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
	'7' AS MarketSegmentSK
	,'VIP' AS MarketSegmentID
	,'VIP' AS MarketSegmentName
	,'TRB >=  P10M' AS MarketSegmentDescription
	,10000000 AS LowerLimit
	,NULL AS UpperLimit
	,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'Manual' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm


END
